encodes: Receipt-to-settlement binding verified offline against a supplied candidate set.
provenance: x402 offer-receipt extension section 5.6.4, as proposed in pull request 3827 at commit 0e492d6 and not on main
description: A version 2 receipt whose authorizationCommitment opens on exactly one of the candidate nonces supplied with it. No chain access is needed because the candidates are given; this is the arithmetic half of section 5.6.4.

context.note: Real payment on Base Sepolia to https://api.tokenizen.nl/api/paid/verify-ownership. Buyer and seller are the same party, which proves the chain closes end to end and nothing about adoption.
